properties.title: Witcher
properties.description: Trained since childhood, a Witcher is a monster hunter with sharpened senses and mastery of the Signs. Unlock Witcher Sense to begin your path.

properties.title: Aard
properties.description: Release a forward shockwave of telekinetic force. Unlock Aard: Wave to hold the key for a 360 degree shockwave instead.

properties.title: Igni
properties.description: Release a cone of fire that damages and ignites enemies. Unlock Igni: Torrent to hold the key for a continuous short-range stream of fire instead.

properties.title: Quen
properties.description: Surround yourself with a protective sign that blocks the next hit you take, then shatters. Lasts up to 15 seconds. Unlock Quen: Dome to crouch-cast a protective dome instead.

properties.title: Witcher Sense
properties.description: Your senses warn you of danger. Hostile mobs within 6 blocks, and players who hurt you in the last 5 minutes, light up the edge of your screen in the direction they are in.

properties.title: Aard: Wave
properties.description: Unlocks the hold form of Aard: hold the key to release a 360 degree shockwave around you.

properties.title: Igni: Torrent
properties.description: Unlocks the hold form of Igni: hold the key to emit a continuous short-range stream of fire.

properties.title: Quen: Dome
properties.description: Unlocks the crouch form of Quen: crouch while casting to raise a protective dome around you that blocks projectiles and pushes enemies away, but slows you down.
